policy_description: Amends citizenship law to grant eligibility for Indian citizenship to persecuted religious minorities from Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan who entered India before 2014, while excluding Muslims from the fast-track path
policy_objective: Provide accelerated citizenship to specified persecuted religious minority groups from three neighboring countries
evidence_text: ABP-CVoter snap poll Dec 17-19 2019: asked do you support the government decision to implement CAA; 62% yes and 37% no; booster samples in Assam, northeast and Muslim community.

policy_description: Proposal to implement a nationwide NRC to identify illegal immigrants building on the Assam NRC process
policy_objective: Establish a nationwide register distinguishing citizens from illegal immigrants
evidence_text: Same ABP-CVoter Dec 2019 poll: asked whether NRC should be implemented across the country; 65% yes and 28% no.

policy_name: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (Women's Reservation Act) 2023
policy_description: Reserves one-third of seats in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies for women upon implementation after census and delimitation
policy_objective: Increase women's representation in national and state legislatures through a 33 percent seat reservation
evidence_text: ABP-CVoter snap poll Sep 2023: asked do you support the Women's Reservation Bill; 75% yes and about 14% opposed; n=5403 adults; margin of error +/-3 percent macro.

policy_description: Three 2020 laws allowing sale of farm produce outside APMC mandis, enabling contract farming, and easing essential commodity stock limits; later repealed in late 2021
policy_objective: Liberalize agricultural marketing and contract farming for farmers
evidence_text: Gaon Connection Rural Report 2 face-to-face survey Oct 3-9 2020 across 53 districts in 16 states; 52% of farmer respondents opposed the three new agri laws and 35% supported them; margin of error five percent.

policy_name: Cryptocurrency and Regulation of Official Digital Currency Bill 2021 (proposed)
policy_description: Proposed bill to regulate cryptocurrencies and create an official RBI digital currency with restrictions on private crypto assets
policy_objective: Regulate private cryptocurrencies and introduce a central bank digital currency
evidence_text: YouGov Omnibus online Nov 30-Dec 7 2021 among 1225 urban Indian adults: 29% support the bill decision; 36% not in favour; 35% unsure; representative of adult online population.

policy_description: Political and legislative push to enact a Uniform Civil Code replacing religion-based personal laws with common civil laws for marriage, divorce, inheritance and adoption
policy_objective: Implement a common civil code for all religious communities
evidence_text: India Today-CVoter Mood of the Nation Jan 2023: 69% of 140917 respondents want UCC implemented in India; additional 105008 tracker interviews analysed; oppose percentage not separately reported in the cited release.

policy_name: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act 2019 (triple talaq ban)
policy_description: Outlaws the practice of instant triple talaq by Muslim men, making it a punishable offence to protect Muslim women's marriage rights
policy_objective: Prohibit instant triple talaq divorce and protect rights of married Muslim women
evidence_text: Pew Research face-to-face Nov 17 2019-Mar 23 2020 n=29999: 68% of Indians say Muslim men should not be allowed to divorce via triple talaq and 14% say the practice should be allowed; 18% did not answer; question measures legality of the practice which is the Act's operative ban.

policy_description: Karnataka government order and High Court upheld restriction requiring school uniforms and barring hijab in classrooms where uniform policies exist
policy_objective: Enforce compulsory school uniforms without religious attire exceptions in state educational institutions
evidence_text: India Today-CVoter MOTN Jan 2023: asked whether hijab should be banned in schools and colleges; 57% favoured a ban and 26% rejected prohibition; n=140917 plus tracker.

policy_name: One Nation One Election (simultaneous elections bills 2024)
policy_description: Constitution 129th Amendment Bill and related proposals to synchronize Lok Sabha and state assembly elections
policy_objective: Synchronize national and state election cycles to reduce election frequency and cost
evidence_text: News18 Pulse survey Dec 23-31 2024 n=4573 across 29 states and UTs: 80.1% support ONOP; 16% not in favour; 3.9% no opinion.

policy_description: India-wide ban on identified single-use plastic items with effect from July 1 2022 under plastic waste management rules
policy_objective: Ban specified single-use plastic products to reduce plastic pollution
evidence_text: Ipsos Global Survey press release Feb 24 2022: 83% of urban Indians polled would like a complete ban on single-use plastics at the earliest; India-specific sample size not stated in the release.

policy_description: Liquor prohibition across Bihar with penalties for manufacture, sale and consumption of alcohol
policy_objective: Prohibit alcohol consumption and sale to improve household welfare and social conditions
evidence_text: CNLU Panchayati Raj Chair with Jeevika government-commissioned survey Dec 2022-Jan 2023 n=1022467 across all 38 districts: 92.12% people in favour of prohibition; women 99.36% in favour; still-consuming share not reported as an oppose percentage.

policy_name: Demonetization of Rs 500 and Rs 1000 notes 2016
policy_description: Invalidation of high denomination currency notes comprising about 86 percent of cash in circulation to curb black money and counterfeit currency
policy_objective: Withdraw old high denomination notes from circulation and push formalization of the economy
evidence_text: Lokniti-CSDS-ABP News MOTN May 1-15 2017 n=11373: 45% said right move; 32% right move but bad preparation; 16% wrong move not required; approval coded as right plus right-with-critique = 77%; disapproval = wrong move 16%.

policy_name: JEE and NEET exams held September 2020
policy_description: Decision to conduct JEE and NEET entrance examinations as scheduled in September 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic with distancing protocols
policy_objective: Conduct national entrance exams on schedule to avoid academic year loss for students
evidence_text: LocalCircles survey Aug 2020 n=10600+ across districts: 63% said exams should be held in September as planned with social distancing; 31% said postpone to December or later; 6% no opinion; citizen panel with validated registered users.

policy_description: 103rd Constitutional Amendment and enabling laws providing 10 percent reservation in government jobs and education for economically weaker sections not covered by existing caste quotas
policy_objective: Provide reservation based on economic status for economically weaker general category citizens
evidence_text: LocalCircles Jul 2019: 76% of citizens supported the government move for 10 percent economic-status reservation; 22% against; 12000+ unique citizens and 30000+ votes across 200+ districts; citizen panel caveat.

policy_description: Government mandate to sell only E20 petrol (20 percent ethanol blended) phased in from 2025, including vehicles not originally designed for higher ethanol blends
policy_objective: Mandate nationwide sale of E20 petrol to cut oil imports and promote biofuels
evidence_text: LocalCircles Aug 2025 among petrol vehicle owners n=14127 on this question: 12% support the E20 mandate; 44% oppose and want it revoked; additional 22% oppose current mandate but would support with consumer options and incentives; disapproval coded as the clear revoke category 44 percent.

policy_name: Proposed GST rate hike (Fitment Committee proposal)
policy_description: Proposal to raise GST rates from 5 percent to 7-8 percent and from 18 percent to 20 percent as discussed by the Fitment Committee of the GST Council
policy_objective: Raise GST slab rates to increase revenue
evidence_text: LocalCircles national survey Jun 2022 on the GST hike question n=9680: only 20% would support an increase from 5% to 7-8% and from 18% to 20%; 71% said no; 9% no opinion; citizen panel caveat.

policy_name: Article 370 revocation (Jammu and Kashmir special status)
policy_description: Abrogation of Article 370 provisions granting special autonomous status to Jammu and Kashmir and reorganisation of the state into two union territories
policy_objective: Withdraw the special constitutional status of Jammu and Kashmir and apply national laws directly
evidence_text: India Today-Karvy Insights Mood of the Nation fieldwork Jul 22-30 2019, n=12126 across 97 parliamentary constituencies in 19 states: 57% said Article 370 should be revoked; oppose percentage not reported; poll fielded just before the Aug 5 2019 decision.

policy_description: Central government decision to cancel CBSE and ICSE Class 12 board examinations in June 2021 during the second Covid-19 wave and adopt an alternative evaluation scheme
policy_objective: Cancel in-person Class 12 board exams to protect student health and evaluate through alternative criteria
evidence_text: IANS-CVoter snap poll (also reported as ABP-CVoter) fieldwork Jun 2 2021 after the Jun 1 cancellation decision, all-India n=5422: 56.4% approved the government decision to cancel Class 12 exams; disapproval not separately reported.

policy_description: Government orders banning Chinese-origin applications such as TikTok and WeChat in tranches from June 2020 following the Ladakh border clash
policy_objective: Block Chinese apps citing data security and national security concerns amid border tensions
evidence_text: India Today-Karvy Insights MOTN fieldwork Jul 15-27 2020, n=12021 across 19 states: 91% said banning Chinese apps and denying contracts to Chinese companies was the right decision while 7% said it was not.

policy_description: Proposal to ban or restrict the sale of China-made products in India as an economic counter to Chinese aggression after the 2020 Ladakh clash
policy_objective: Restrict Chinese imports and promote domestic alternatives through a government ban
evidence_text: Same India Today-Karvy MOTN fieldwork Jul 15-27 2020 n=12021: 90% of respondents were in favour of a ban on China-made products in the country while 7% were not; no nationwide import ban was enacted so the measure is coded as proposed.

policy_description: Supreme Court and state restrictions on firecracker sale and bursting during Diwali including green-cracker mandates, chemical limits and total bans in some states
policy_objective: Limit firecracker bursting to reduce air and noise pollution during the festival season
evidence_text: LocalCircles survey released Nov 2 2021 with close to 28000 total responses from 371 districts: on whether restrictions should be placed on cracker burning, 42% favoured some form of ban (28% national, 8% state, 6% district level) while 53% said no restrictions are needed and 5% had no opinion; responses to this specific question not separately reported (sibling questions n=9257-9363); citizen panel caveat.

policy_description: Petition seeking recognition of same-sex marriages under the Special Marriage Act, rejected by the Supreme Court in October 2023; opinion survey fielded before the verdict
policy_objective: Grant marital recognition and associated legal rights to same-sex couples
evidence_text: Pew Research Center face-to-face probability survey in India fieldwork Mar 25-May 11 2023, n=2611 adults weighted to national benchmarks: 53% said same-sex marriage should be legal and 43% opposed; fielded before the Supreme Court's October 2023 rejection.

policy_name: Strict lockdown in high virus-load districts May 2020
policy_description: Continuation of complete lockdown with no red-zone relaxations in the 27 highest Covid-19 load districts as the government prepared Unlock guidelines from May 18 2020
policy_objective: Keep high infection districts under full lockdown to contain Covid-19 spread despite economic reopening pressure
evidence_text: LocalCircles survey of May 3 2020, n=8288 voters from 124 districts with 88% residing in the 27 high-load districts: 74% said no lockdown relaxations should be given in high virus-load districts while 25% said red-zone relaxations must apply and 1% had no opinion; citizen panel caveat.

policy_description: Bill to amend the Waqf Act 1995 introducing mandatory registration of Waqf properties with district collectors and dispute resolution through regular courts
policy_objective: Increase transparency and governmental oversight in Waqf board governance
evidence_text: LocalCircles survey released Sep 12 2024 (overall 47000+ responses from 388 districts): the question 'Would you support such a bill that brings transparency in Waqf board workings?' received n=15951 responses with 91% yes absolutely, 8% no and 1% unclear; bill was with a joint parliamentary committee at survey time; citizen panel caveat.

policy_name: Delhi odd-even vehicle rationing rule November 2023
policy_description: Odd-even alternate-day rationing of private cars on Delhi roads from November 13-20 2023 as an anti-pollution measure with several exemptions
policy_objective: Cut vehicular emissions during a severe pollution period by restricting alternate-day private car use
evidence_text: LocalCircles survey released Nov 9 2023 among Delhi-NCR residents: asked 'Do you support the introduction of Odd-Even vehicle rules in Delhi from Nov 13-20th as a step to reduce air pollution?', 36% of n=10644 respondents said yes and 64% said no (binary question reported as summing to 100); overall survey received 21000+ responses; citizen panel caveat.

policy_description: Strategic civilian nuclear cooperation agreement with the United States operationalised after the July 2008 Lok Sabha trust vote
policy_objective: Enable civilian nuclear trade and cooperation with the United States and international suppliers
evidence_text: Outlook magazine poll conducted by GfK-Mode published Jul 12 2008 among n=1217 respondents across six metros (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai): asked 'Do you think the nuclear deal is in the interest of the country?', 59% yes, 35% no and 6% don't know; urban six-metro sample caveat; fielded ahead of the Jul 22 2008 trust vote.

policy_description: Government and Supreme Court backed decision to re-test only the 1563 grace-mark candidates of NEET-UG 2024 while allowing counselling to continue for all
policy_objective: Address grace-mark irregularities through a limited re-test without cancelling the entire exam
evidence_text: Hindustan Times online reader poll of Jun 21 2024 with n=1934 as reported in the cited HT article: asked whether the NEET 2024 exam should be scrapped completely or whether re-exam for a few as planned is the correct approach, 40% said the limited re-exam approach was correct while 56% preferred scrapping the exam completely and 4% were unsure; approval coded for the government's selective re-test approach; self-selected web reader poll caveat.

policy_name: 28 percent GST on online gaming and casinos
policy_description: Proposal accepted by the GST Council to impose 28 percent GST on the full face value of online gaming, casinos and horse racing transactions
policy_objective: Raise tax rates on online gaming, casinos and horse racing to 28 percent
evidence_text: LocalCircles national survey released Jun 17 2022 (survey 34000+ responses from 319 districts): question on what the GST rate for online gaming, casinos and horse racing should be received n=12097 responses; 45% said 28%, 7% said 40% and 27% said over 50% aggregating to 79% wanting 28% or higher, while 15% wanted 18% or lower and 6% had no opinion; citizen panel caveat.

policy_name: State anti-conversion laws prohibiting conversion for marriage
policy_description: Laws in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Madhya Pradesh criminalising religious conversion by force, allurement or for marriage
policy_objective: Prohibit fraudulent or coerced religious conversions especially through marriage
evidence_text: India Today-Karvy Insights MOTN fieldwork Jan 3-13 2021, n=12232 across 19 states: 58% backed laws passed to discourage inter-faith marriages (question: should a law be passed against inter-faith marriage, yes 58% and no 35%); policies of UP, Uttarakhand and MP at survey time.

policy_description: Four-year short-term contractual recruitment scheme for the armed forces with a one-time severance package and limited retention of about 25 percent
policy_objective: Reform military recruitment through short-service Agniveer tenures with partial permanent absorption
evidence_text: AajTak-India Today-CVoter MOTN fieldwork Jul 15-Aug 10 2024, n=136463: asked whether the Agniveer scheme should continue, 27% said yes unconditionally, 38% said yes with some reforms, 27% opposed and about 8% had no opinion; approval coded as the combined continue share of 65% per the source's own summary that 65% back the scheme with 38% wanting improvements.

policy_description: Parliamentary repeal of the three 2020 farm reform laws (contract farming agreement, barrier-free trade outside APMC mandis, Essential Commodities Amendment) after the year-long farmers' protest
policy_objective: Undo the 2020 agricultural marketing reforms and restore the pre-2020 regulatory arrangement
evidence_text: IANS-CVoter national snap poll fielded within hours of PM Modi's Nov 19 2021 repeal announcement, about 3000 respondents interviewed across all states in 11 languages (India Tracker): more than 52 per cent said the Prime Minister took the right decision by repealing the farm laws (coded 52); a related item found over 50 per cent called the laws beneficial against 30.6 per cent who did not. Disapproval share not reported in the release, left blank. Figures also carried by Times of India (IANS) and analysed in ThePrint; Act passed Nov 29 2021.

policy_name: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita criminal code package (BNS/BNSS/BSA)
policy_description: Wholesale replacement of the Indian Penal Code 1860, Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 and Indian Evidence Act 1872 with the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, in force from July 1 2024
policy_objective: Modernise criminal justice with new offence definitions, zero FIRs, online complaint registration and time-bound procedures
evidence_text: India Today Group-CVoter MOTN fieldwork Jul 15 - Aug 10 2024 plus 24-week tracker, n=136463: asked how the three new criminal laws are, 22 per cent said necessary, 31 per cent said good but needing reforms/checks, 22 per cent said wrong, remainder no opinion. Approval coded as the source's own published aggregate of 53 per cent who endorse the laws (22+31), per India Today editor's note, Sep 2 2024 issue; disapproval is the source-reported wrong share of 22. Re-judged from the pilot-era multi-option exclusion because the source itself publishes the combined endorsement figure (same treatment as PP030).

policy_name: Criminal Law (Amendment) Ordinance 2018 - death penalty for child rape
policy_description: Ordinance (replaced by the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act 2018) raising rape punishments and introducing the death penalty for rape and gang rape of girls under 12 years, with amendments to POCSO
policy_objective: Deter rape of minors through sharply enhanced minimum sentences including capital punishment
evidence_text: LocalCircles nationwide polls conducted Apr 21-23 2018 immediately after the Union Cabinet promulgated the Criminal Law (Amendment) Ordinance 2018 (over 40000 votes across six related questions; question-level n not published, left blank): 76 per cent said child rapists should get the death penalty, 18 per cent chose life without parole and 3 per cent the existing term; a companion item found 89 per cent wanted their state to pass a stringent death-penalty law within six months. Coded as support for the ordinance's death-penalty provision; the question offered no explicit oppose option so disapproval is left blank. Reported by India TV (IANS) and Zee News.

policy_name: Himachal Pradesh Old Pension Scheme restoration
policy_description: Himachal Pradesh government decision to restore the guaranteed 1972-pattern Old Pension Scheme for state employees covered under the National Pension System, announced in the first cabinet meeting Jan 13 2023 and notified May 4 2023
policy_objective: Replace the contributory market-linked NPS with a government-funded guaranteed pension for state employees
evidence_text: Lokniti-CSDS post-poll study of Himachal Pradesh assembly voters (Nov-Dec 2022): 74 per cent were aware of the Congress promise to restore the Old Pension Scheme and among those aware, an overwhelming 70 per cent supported restoration (support figure is conditional on awareness exactly as published; sub-sample n not reported, left blank). Coded 70 as the published support for the specific promise. State scope (Himachal voters only). Implemented via cabinet decision of Jan 13 2023 and Office Memorandum Fin(Pen)A(3)-1/2023 dated May 4 2023.

policy_description: Union government bearing the cost of COVID-19 vaccination doses, with universal free provision for all adults announced from June 21 2021 alongside the national immunisation drive
policy_objective: Remove price barriers to COVID-19 immunisation and maximise coverage of the vaccination drive
evidence_text: India Today Mood of the Nation poll, January 2021 round (fieldwork Dec 2020 - Jan 2021): 92 per cent of respondents wanted the COVID-19 shot to be free of cost and 76 per cent said they were willing to take the jab. Sample size for the round not restated with the item, left blank; no oppose share reported for the free-of-cost item, disapproval left blank. The question addresses government vaccine pricing policy; universal free vaccination for all adults followed on June 21 2021.

policy_description: Direct income support of Rs 6000 per year in three instalments to small and marginal farmer landholding families
policy_objective: Supplement farmer incomes through direct benefit transfer
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: covers about 11 crore landholding farmer families; Rs 6000/year paid in three DBT instalments.

policy_description: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for the bottom 40 per cent of households under SECC deprivation categories
policy_objective: Provide public-funded health assurance against catastrophic medical expenditure
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, about 55 crore beneficiaries; Rs 5 lakh cover per family per year.

policy_description: Housing for All (urban) programme providing affordable houses to EWS and LIG families, later extended through PMAY-Urban 2.0 approved August 2024
policy_objective: Eliminate urban housing shortage by enabling affordable housing for eligible urban households
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: central assistance for construction/interest subsidy; PMAY-U 2.0 (Aug 2024) sanctioned about 1 crore urban houses over five years.

policy_description: Nationwide sanitation programme financing household and community toilets and behaviour change; rural phase declared ODF in October 2019, Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 ongoing since 2021
policy_objective: End open defecation and improve solid waste management and sanitation outcomes
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: over 11 crore household toilets built in rural India; ODF declared Oct 2 2019; SBM 2.0 focuses on waste management and sludge treatment.

policy_description: Har Ghar Jal programme providing functional household tap connections with potable water to rural households
policy_objective: Provide safe drinking water through piped tap connections to every rural household
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: about 79 per cent rural households with FHTC coverage at the time of writing per mission portal; targets universal coverage by 2028.

policy_description: Free LPG connections with first refill subsidy to women of poor households, relaunched as Ujjwala 2.0 in August 2021
policy_objective: Replace polluting solid cooking fuels with clean LPG in poor households
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: over 10 crore connections released; free connection plus subsidy support; refills delivered via PAHAL DBT.

policy_description: Universal access to banking with zero-balance accounts, RuPay debit cards, overdraft and direct benefit transfer integration
policy_objective: Ensure access to basic banking services and financial inclusion for every household
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: over 53 crore accounts opened with deposits above Rs 2.3 lakh crore as per scheme portal; gateway for DBT and Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile linking.

policy_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
policy_description: Statutory guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per rural household per year on unskilled manual work
policy_objective: Provide a legal employment safety net to rural households
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: demand-driven work scheme covering all rural districts; about 15-16 crore households typically provided employment annually as per ministry data.

policy_description: Statutory entitlement to subsidised foodgrains (rice, wheat, coarse grains) covering up to 75 per cent of rural and 50 per cent of urban population, with targeted allocations for priority households
policy_objective: Provide subsidised foodgrains as a legal entitlement against hunger
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: about 81.35 crore beneficiaries under NFSA (TPDS) after 2021 National Database of Eligible Households exercise; cash transfers operate in some UTs.

policy_description: Maternity benefit of Rs 5000 in three instalments to pregnant and lactating mothers for the first living child, with a partial-holiday variant
policy_objective: Compensate wage loss and support nutrition during pregnancy and lactation
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: conditional cash benefit of Rs 5000 (Rs 6000 in states with MMR below national average under PMSMA-linked criteria) paid in instalments via DBT.

policy_name: Poshan Abhiyaan (Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme for Holistic Nourishment)
policy_description: National nutrition mission with stunting reduction targets, nutrition and wellness centres, technology-based monitoring (Poshan Tracker) and behaviour change communication
policy_objective: Reduce stunting, undernutrition, anaemia and low birth weight among children and women
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: mission targets reduction of stunting among children under six by 2 percentage points per year; Poshan Tracker monitors beneficiary services.

policy_description: Education policy replacing NEP 1986: 5+3+3+4 school structure, mother-tongue medium instruction, coding from class 6, multidisciplinary undergraduate programmes with multiple exit options
policy_objective: Overhaul school and higher education to be multidisciplinary, accessible and rooted in local languages
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: NEP 2020 approved by the Union Cabinet July 29 2020; replaces NEP 1986 and is being rolled out through NCF reforms, AICTE/UGC curriculum revisions and the four-year undergraduate structure from 2025-26.

policy_description: Consent-based framework for processing digital personal data, Data Protection Board of India, notice and consent obligations and duties of significant data fiduciaries
policy_objective: Protect the personal data of individuals while permitting lawful processing for legitimate purposes
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: Parliament passed the DPDP Bill on August 11 2023; rules framed in 2025 and staged implementation of Data Protection Board operationalisation follows.

policy_name: Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules 2021
policy_description: Rules under the IT Act 2000 requiring due diligence, 72-hour grievance redressal, removal of unlawful content within statutory timeframes and compliance reporting for significant social media intermediaries
policy_objective: Regulate online intermediaries and digital news media for user safety, transparency and lawful content
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: notified February 25 2021 under the IT Act 2000; significant intermediaries must identify the first originator of information in specified cases and publish monthly compliance reports.

policy_description: Replaces the Indian Telegraph Act 1885: authorisation-based telecom licensing, administratively assigned spectrum, OTT communication service provisions and encryption/privacy safeguards
policy_objective: Modernise telecom regulation and enable orderly assignment and use of spectrum
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: passed December 20 2023, assented December 24 2023; spectrum assignment by auction with exceptions; telecom service definition extended to data services.

policy_name: Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act 2016
policy_description: Legal framework for Aadhaar-based unique identity and authentication for targeted delivery of subsidies, benefits and services
policy_objective: Provide a unique digital identity to residents for efficient and leak-free delivery of benefits
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: more than 1.39 billion Aadhaar numbers generated; authentication used for DBT, banking and telecom KYC under Supreme Court and statutory safeguards.

policy_description: Umbrella programme covering digital infrastructure (BharatNet), digital services (e-Governance, UMANG, DigiLocker) and digital empowerment of citizens
policy_objective: Transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: launched July 1 2015 across nine pillars; BharatNet fibre connectivity extended to about 2.14 lakh gram panchayats as per program disclosures.

policy_description: Constitution (101st Amendment) Act 2016 and GST Council replacing multiple indirect taxes with a unified nationwide consumption tax, implemented from July 1 2017
policy_objective: Replace cascading indirect taxes with a harmonised national consumption tax
evidence_text: Lokniti-CSDS-ABP News Mood of the Nation Survey (fieldwork Jan 7-20 2018, n=14,336 across 19 states, 175 PCs): asked whether the introduction of GST was a necessary decision or an unnecessary one that could have been avoided, 44 per cent said necessary and 30 per cent unnecessary with 26 per cent not responding - the survey report's own published summary table (component option counts give 44.5 and 29.1 unweighted). Approval 44 below 50 hence Rejected. The separate careful-versus-haste question (27 per cent careful, 42 per cent haste) is deliberately not used for labelling per dataset rules.

policy_description: Time-bound corporate insolvency resolution with a 330-day deadline, creditor-in-possession framework, resolution professionals and an insolvency regulator
policy_objective: Resolve insolvency efficiently and improve the ease of doing business through predictable exit rules
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: IBC enacted December 2016 with amendments in 2018-2021; over 10,000 corporate insolvency cases admitted and large sums realised for creditors as per IBBI newsletters.

policy_description: PLI schemes across 14 sectors with roughly Rs 1.97 lakh crore outlay rewarding incremental manufacturing sales and investment commitments
policy_objective: Boost domestic manufacturing, exports and supply chain resilience
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: notified across electronics, telecom, pharma, food processing and 10 other sectors from 2020-21; cumulative investments and production figures reported by DPIIT.

policy_description: Decriminalises 183 provisions across 42 central Acts and converts 13 penal provisions into monetary penalties while upgrading offences with compounding provisions
policy_objective: Reduce compliance burden and improve the ease of doing business for firms and citizens
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: passed July 2023; amends Acts including the Copyright Act, Environment Protection Act and Food and Adulteration provisions.

policy_description: Defined-contribution market-linked retirement savings scheme for new government entrants and voluntary participation by citizens, regulated by PFRDA
policy_objective: Provide a portable retirement savings vehicle with market-linked returns
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: introduced January 1 2004 for new central government entrants; NPS assets under management crossed Rs 13 lakh crore in 2025 per PFRDA disclosures.

policy_name: Black Money (Undisclosed Foreign Income and Assets) and Imposition of Tax Act 2015
policy_description: Tax at 30 per cent plus 90 per cent penalty and imprisonment up to 10 years on undisclosed foreign income and assets, alongside the Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Amendment Act 2016
policy_objective: Deter and penalise stashing of undisclosed income abroad
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: enacted in the 2016 budget session; provides a one-time compliance window historically and severe penalties for undisclosed foreign assets.

policy_description: National online trading platform linking APMC mandis with unified licensing, e-auction and quality assaying infrastructure
policy_objective: Create a national barrier-free electronic market for farm produce
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: connects more than 1,400 mandis across states on a common platform; interoperable with some state portals.

policy_description: Crop insurance at nominal farmer premium (2 per cent kharif, 1.5 per cent rabi, 5 per cent commercial and horticultural crops) against natural calamities and crop loss
policy_objective: Provide affordable crop insurance against yield and weather losses
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: covers about 5.5 crore farmers in recent seasons as per scheme reports; premium largely subsidised by central and state governments.

policy_description: Policy framework aiming to double agricultural exports (later revised target of USD 100 billion by 2030) through horticulture clusters, APEDA support and removal of non-tariff trade barriers
policy_objective: Raise farm export earnings and connect Indian farmers to global markets
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: approved by the Union Cabinet October 11 2018 with a near-term target of USD 60 billion and long-term USD 100 billion; implemented with APEDA and state inputs.

policy_description: Krushi Abhijan livelihood and investment support: Rs 10000 per farming family per year in two instalments for crop cultivation and livelihood support, offered in place of a farm loan waiver
policy_objective: Provide investment and livelihood support to small and marginal farmers of Odisha
evidence_text: UNLABELLED: no policy-specific public-opinion survey located. Facts: launched February 2019 by the Biju Janata Dal government; covers landless labourers in a separate component; state-scope scheme.

policy_description: Direct investment support of Rs 5000 per acre per year to farm landowners for agriculture and horticulture inputs, raised to Rs 6000 per acre from the 2023 cycle
